title: Change the translation language
summary: Set Apple Translate to Mandarin Chinese and translate a short phrase.
startingConditions: Apple Translate is open on its translation screen.
steps: Type “Where is the train station?” and translate it.
evidence: The recording shows the language being selected and the final translated result.
notes: Labels differ by iOS version and region. If the option is missing, submit the attempt as blocked.

title: Make the text bigger
summary: Increase the system text size so menus are easier to read.
startingConditions: Start on the Home Screen. Note the current text size so you can restore it afterwards.
steps: Open Settings → Display & Brightness → Text Size.
Drag the slider two steps to the right.
Go back and show that menu text is now larger.
evidence: The recording shows the slider moving and larger text in Settings afterwards.
notes: Put the slider back afterwards; that does not need to be recorded.

title: Set a morning alarm
summary: Create an 8:00 AM alarm that repeats on weekdays.
steps: Under Repeat choose Monday to Friday.
Save, and show the new alarm in the list.
evidence: The recording shows the time, the repeat days, and the saved alarm.
notes: Delete the alarm afterwards if you do not want it.

title: Turn the flashlight on and off
summary: Use Control Center to switch the flashlight on, then off again.
startingConditions: Start on the Home Screen with the flashlight off.
steps: Swipe down from the top-right corner to open Control Center.
Tap the flashlight button to turn it on.
Tap it again to turn it off, then close Control Center.
evidence: The recording shows the flashlight button switching on and off.
notes: If the flashlight is not in Control Center, submit the attempt as blocked.

title: Silence unknown callers
summary: Turn on the setting that sends calls from unknown numbers to voicemail.
startingConditions: Start on the Home Screen with Silence Unknown Callers off.
steps: Open Settings → Apps → Phone (or Settings → Phone on older iOS).
evidence: The recording shows the switch turning on.
notes: The menu location changed in recent iOS versions. Turn it back off afterwards if you want.
